reads_as: DEVS ARE BACK over a relieved wojak while a magnifier hovers AI logos
layout_map: Black grid-paper background scattered with confetti dots. Two-tone Inter-900 headline spans the full top edge, baseline ~y55, cells 1-4: 'Devs are' in white then 'BACK' in red caps, BACK sitting in cell 3-4 (~x430-x600). A blue line-art bald wojak (relieved/teary) fills the left-center, head in cells 5-6 (~x120-x300, head center ~x180,y160), shoulders to bottom. Right of center a white circular magnifier lens (~x430-x600, y90-y180, cells 7-8) frames three AI logos in a row — a colored model glyph, 'Claude' sunburst, and a green OpenAI/Gemini spiral mark (~x560,y150, cell 12). A photo hand with pointing finger enters from bottom-right corner (~x600,y180, cell 12) aimed at the lens.
why_it_works: The relieved face plus magnified logo cluster says 'I investigated the AI tools so you don't have to' — reassurance after a scare.
mimic_for: a reassuring verdict after a panic — 'the tool/role survives', a calmed take on a feared trend
title: The AI Bubble is BURSTING…
